pages.title: Answerfinch: Conditional email notifications for Google Forms
pages.description: Answerfinch is a Google Forms™ add-on that sends emails based on form answers. On Free you run one rule at a time across your Google account. Pro is $4 a month or $29 a year.
Google Forms email notifications not arriving? Check Google's own notification settings first, then the Answerfinch send log, rules and daily sending limit.
What to check when you pick a Google Forms email add-on. Compare plan limits, conditions and recipients, with dates and product sources.

pages.title: Email different people based on Google Forms checkbox answers | Answerfinch
pages.description: Send Google Forms checkbox answers to different people. See how to group choices for one inbox and test two routes from one response.

pages.title: Send different Google Forms confirmation emails based on an answer | Answerfinch
pages.description: Send different confirmation emails to Google Forms respondents. Write one message for each answer and check both messages before you share the form.

pages.title: Free ways to send conditional emails from Google Forms | Answerfinch
pages.description: Compare ways to send email when a Google Forms answer matches. Check built-in settings, Apps Script, Workspace Studio, workflow tools and add-ons.

pages.title: Send email based on a Google Forms answer with Apps Script | Answerfinch
pages.description: Write a form-bound Apps Script that sends an email when a Google Forms answer matches. Test a form submit trigger and decide when to use an add-on.

pages.title: Send Google Forms email notifications to multiple people | Answerfinch
pages.description: Send the same Google Forms response notification to multiple people. See when to use personal alerts, a Google Group address or one rule per address.

pages.title: Get Google Forms email notifications with responses included | Answerfinch
pages.description: Get Google Forms answers by email. Use Email me every response for your first rule or choose which answers to include.
